summary.en: An illegal gold mine in southwest Colombia collapsed, killing 14 miners and injuring 7. A Colombian judge ordered protection of historical artifacts after a museum purge sparked protests, during which security forces used water cannons on demonstrators in Bogotá. The government is preparing a decree to define maritime boundaries for the San Andres, Providencia and Santa Catalina Archipelago while former rebel leaders face war crimes charges related to Indigenous groups. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
